summary: Phase 3 Logistics AI (Delay Predictions + Konekt Copilot + Demand↔Delivery) fully verified end-to-end on flour.admin@tradekonekt.io. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases PASSED in 31s against the preview URL (file /app/backend/tests/test_logistics_ai.py). Coverage: predictions payload shape (items[] with vehicle_code/risk_level/probability/predicted_delay_min/reason/recommendation/dest_name/status, counts{high,medium,low}, fleet_scored, source='vertex-ai' confirmed on every run, created_at), 10-min cache hit (identical created_at), ?refresh=true forces recompute (new created_at), copilot/chat returns reply+session_id+model+provider='vertex-ai' grounded with TK-/RT- codes, copilot multi-turn (2nd turn referenced 1st within same session — Gemini answered the follow-up with concrete numbers), 400 on empty/whitespace message, copilot/history is chronological with user/assistant alternation, demand-delivery 7 regions with realistic varied trends (NOT all +100%) + 2-4 vertex-ai insights, 15-min cache + refresh recompute, tenant security (distributor → 403 on all three endpoints). Verified delay_predicted emit code path + 60-min dedupe exist in /app/backend/services/delay_predictor.py (no high-risk trucks live — fleet is healthy, which is correct behaviour). Phase-1+2 regression: 38/38 PASSED on test_control_tower.py + test_route_planning.py. Frontend (Playwright on https://supply-chain-hub-189.preview.emergentagent.com): login → /manufacturer/logistics-center → tab-ai-insights → logistics-ai-view renders with ai-provider-badge='Gemini · Vertex AI'; delay-predictions-panel shows predictions-source='GEMINI REASONING' + 4 prediction-row entries each with prediction-risk-badge=LOW (fleet healthy); demand-delivery-panel shows 4 dd-insight bullets + 7 dd-region-row with pressure badges; CopilotPanel — sent 'How many trucks are active right now?' → grounded reply 'There are 5 trucks active right now.' (bold rendered via <strong>, no raw ** asterisks), follow-up 'Are any of those trucks at risk of delay?' → reply cited TK-101 + RT-006 (multi-turn context retained), messages persisted after full page reload (10 messages → 10 messages), predictions-refresh-btn re-scored (still vertex-ai), dd-refresh-btn re-computed. Regression tabs tab-control-tower (control-tower-view) + tab-route-planning (route-planning-view) still render. ZERO console errors throughout entire session.

issues: Markdown unordered-list bullets render as raw '*   ' text in assistant messages (e.g. 'Yes, one truck is at risk of delay:\n\n*   TK-101 is currently `in_transit`...'). Bold (**...**) IS rendered correctly via <strong>, but the markdown renderer does not handle '* ' / '- ' bullets. Cosmetic — content is correct and grounded — but degrades readability of lists. Consider switching to react-markdown or extend the existing parser to handle ul/li and inline code (backticks like `in_transit` also show as raw text).

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Upgrade CopilotPanel message renderer to handle markdown bullet lists ('* ', '- ', '1. ') and inline code (`...`) — currently only **bold** is parsed, so Gemini's list responses show raw '*   ' markers.
